provenance.note: Owner-authorized reviewed chapter 7 production authoring, 5 October 2026. All 36 individual canonical/source screen/activity/exercise identities, retained variants, 29/25 physical responses, 10+8/9+9 partitions, observed support timing and analytical indexing remain preserved. Literal Japanese, readings, explanations, translations, banks and accepted alternatives are app authored/adapted, not recovered quotations. Dictionary-form typed できる/dekiru is occurrence-specific with fixed の. Contrastive は marks contextual contrast without guaranteeing exhaustive exclusion or possible alternatives. Limited feedback has cues only; unknown feedback is supplied app content. No retry, speaking or optional production endpoint. Text polish 1.1.0 (8 October 2026, owner-approved text-only pass over 1.0.0): learner-facing wording, Australian English spelling, reading-line spacing and instruction-template wording were revised. Answer keys, accepted forms, tokens, option sets/IDs/order, screen IDs, partitions, counts, retry policies, source contracts, evidence and support timing/visibility are unchanged from 1.0.0; b2-polish/pack-text-validation.mjs verifies this.

screens.prompt: Notice the meaning of できる with a newly built shop.

before.text: 駅の前に新しい店ができました。
A new shop has been built in front of the station.

できる can mean that something new comes into existence: a shop is built, a friendship forms or produce grows. With a language or an activity, it can express ability. Context identifies the meaning; the thing that comes into existence is marked with が.

screens.prompt: Listen and insert three characters to form the て-form.

after.text: 近くに店ができて、便利になりました。
after.secondary: ちかくにみせができて、べんりになりました。

after.text: A shop opened nearby, and things became more convenient.
できる is a る-verb: replace る with て to make できて. The て-form links the new shop with the resulting convenience.

screens.prompt: Listen and type the dictionary form before の. Use kana or romaji.

after.text: 新しい学校で友達ができるのはうれしいです。
after.secondary: あたらしいがっこうでともだちができるのはうれしいです。
